correctness.rationale: Mass balance gives H=kappa(a0 u(0,t)+aL u(L,t)), and the reflected Brownian local-time representation with integrable boundary hazard gives strictly positive S_infty. Subtracting S/L from the Neumann heat-kernel mild formula produces an L1-in-time centered kernel with exponentially decaying tail; dominated convergence yields uniform u->S_infty/L and w/kappa->-S_infty/L sum a_j G_j. Integrating the centered Neumann kernel gives G_0=L/D(1/3-y+y^2/2) and G_L=L/D(-1/6+y^2/2); these have zero spatial mean and correct unequal boundary slopes. Integrating the exact positive flux asymptotic yields the survival tail. Fresh independent checks verified both Green-function derivatives, zero mean and cosine-series approximations with maximum discrepancy near 1e-9. No simulation establishes the infinite-time theorem; kernel estimates do.
residual_risks: Bounded initial density and power-law p>1 are essential to the explicit dominated-convergence argument; no uniform assertion near alpha=0.
S_infty is positive but given implicitly by model evolution, not in elementary closed form.

value.rationale: The explicit normalized survivor profile is an exact, naturally motivated quantitative observable for reactive transport that is not fixed by the known power-law tail; it also closes the previously unspecified tail amplitude relative to the nonreacting mass, preserving realistic asymmetric wall reactivity. This is a useful structural refinement even though S_infty itself remains implicit.
residual_risks: A generic boundary perturbation theorem could simplify the derivation and reduce conceptual novelty, but the exact interval expression is still a concrete invariant.

final_claim: For diffusion with integrably decaying time-dependent Robin reactivities a_0 kappa(t),a_L kappa(t) on a finite interval, kappa(t)=kappa_*(1+t/t0)^(-1-alpha) with alpha>0, S_infty>0 and H(t)~ S_infty (a0+aL) kappa(t)/L. The normalized survivor density has explicit uniform first-order quadratic profile in x/L and S(t)-S_infty has coefficient S_infty(a0+aL)kappa_* t0^(1+alpha)/(L alpha).
